main_body: Long low wooden trough, about 36px wide, heaped with green hay. A hay surface sits on top and a wooden front face with inset panels sits below.
top_band: Green hay surface with yellow straw flecks, rows 4-8, topped by a lighter cream/orange rim row at rows 9-10.
evidence: A single column reads: green hay (rows 4-8, mottled, several greens), a cream front-edge highlight (row 9), an orange lip (row 10), a dark brown shadow line (row 11), then a brown front face with inset panels and dark dividers (rows 12-14) over a dark base. The top is a clearly visible horizontal surface of 5 rows, not a thin rim. The hay fills the opening instead of showing an ellipse, but its interior surface is seen from above. Marginal, but it passes.

style.evidence: The hay has about 4-5 greens with yellow flecks, giving clumpy texture. The wood has cream, orange, mid brown and dark brown steps, outlined in dark brown rather than black. The front panels are fairly plain, and the piece is a little simpler than the stall and well references. No large flat fills reach 5x5px, so it is acceptable.
